about: Re-check of code-paper links that no cited sentence confirmed (26 October 2026). For each link, a program scored every sentence in the whole paper against the code's wording and listed the eight closest (recheck.py). The reader then judged whether one of them states the code: 'states it', 'leans on it' (related but less direct), 'not stated', or 'not readable' (text did not extract). Read by Claude Opus 5.5 in a Claude Code session with prompt 4 (harness_v2/docs/codebook/drafts/prompt_draft2.md); to be confirmed by the researchers. Links that state or lean on the code join its evidence; the others are listed in the codebook trail as checked and not confirmed.
